correctness.rationale: For each of 16 de Bruijn graph vertices the local incoming-to-outgoing edge matching is one of two bijections; all \(2^{16}\) assignments are tested, accepting exactly single-cycle permutations. Independent DFS of Euler circuits starting with 00000 gives an identical 2048-member normalized set. Distinct five-bit circular windows preclude borders of length 5 through 31. Both full direct prefix/suffix checking and centered circular-square checking through border length four agree on all 65536 rotations. Fixed \(u_1=16\) and \(u_2=4\) follow from uniform length-2 and length-4 factor counts. Exact seven-profile table and orbit-cell sums reproduce the claimed distribution, moments and 528 orbits. Attached code reruns these tests and has no external dependencies.

value.rationale: Unbordered conjugates and shortest borders are established string invariants, and de Bruijn cycles are canonical universal cyclic words. The complete order-five constrained distribution (seven refined profiles) is neither a one-off arbitrary slice nor a direct consequence of the unrestricted extremal theory; it exhibits strong rigidity (only 8–10 unbordered cuts of 32) and records symmetry-orbit frequencies. Order five is the first substantial full binary family (2048 cycles), and these exact benchmarks inform conjectures and constructions at higher orders without making unsupported extrapolation.
